verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is the product's own no-code builder for verification workflows. A workflow run is created from the backend, and results come back asynchronously by webhook or polling, so some server-side orchestration happens without manual involvement. Each run is a one-off, per-applicant execution that depends on the end user completing interactive capture steps; there is no evidence of recurring schedules, event-triggered background jobs, or ongoing autonomous automations. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring automation runs, autonomous background triggers independent of user capture, any agentic or AI-driven automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Build workflows visually using our no-code Workflow Builder tool, in a format similar to flow charts or process diagrams.
create an applicant → create a workflow run (returns an SDK token) → collect captures via SDK → retrieve results via webhook or polling
asynchronously monitor the status of identity verification workflows by configuring webhook events to notify you of changes in workflow status
